title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Bright soundboard captures a tight, high‑energy second set with smoking China Cat → Rider, Samson & Delilah and an uplifting I Ko I Ko out of space.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, bright‑sounding soundboard that lets the band’s tight arrangements shine. The second set is highlighted as one of the group’s most energetic performances of ’82, packed with standout moments from China Cat Sunrise through I Ko I Ko and closing with Black Peter and Bertha.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both the musical performance (tight, energetic, many standout songs) and the soundboard quality (bright, clear), with no negative comments across seven detailed reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bright, very clear mix; drums especially well‑captured; no noted dropouts or muddiness.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Need a Miracle (Rider)
I Ko I Ko (out of space)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set packed with high‑energy gems before Drum/Space, smooth transitions and a strong finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: High‑energy guitar work noted; contributes to the tight, fiery feel of the set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummer’s sound is especially bright and well‑captured, adding punch to the performance.
